maddeler.e:
أشتغل (form VIII)
# أَشْتَغِلُ (ʔaštaḡilu) /ʔaʃ.ta.ɣi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
# أَشْتَغِلَ (ʔaštaḡila) /ʔaʃ.ta.ɣi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
# أَشْتَغِلْ (ʔaštaḡil) /ʔaʃ.ta.ɣil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
